notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
